tools.name: clawbot_send
tools.description: Send a WeChat reply through the ClawBot channel. It goes to the person whose inbound message arrived most recently. The channel is 1:1 and reply-only, so a context token from that message must still be valid. The send happens immediately.

summary.zh: 回复最近一条微信消息；只能发给刚发消息的人。
summary.en: Reply to the latest WeChat message; sends only to the person who just wrote.

tools.name: clawbot_status
tools.description: Show the WeChat ClawBot connection, bound account, last inbound message time and last error.

summary.zh: 查看微信 ClawBot 连接、账号、最近消息和错误。
summary.en: Show the WeChat ClawBot connection, account, last message and errors.

tools.name: clawbot_events
tools.description: Read archived WeChat events by kind and time. kind supports * (for example message/*). raw defaults to true and never includes context tokens.

raw.description: Include meta.raw. Default true; set false for a compact result.

summary.zh: 按类型和时间查已归档的微信事件。
summary.en: Read archived WeChat events by kind and time.

description.zh: 一条微信私聊消息；正文是可读的一行，meta.raw 是去掉 context_token 的原始事件。
description.en: A WeChat 1:1 message; text is a readable line and meta.raw is the original event without context tokens.

changelog.0.1.0:
- 通过微信 ClawBot（iLink）做 1v1 文本收发：扫码绑定、长轮询收消息、`clawbot_send` 回复。
- 连接状态和「重新连接」在控制台面板与 `clawbot_status` 里；连接、断开和会话过期不投递事件。
- 网络出口可选 `inherit` / `direct` / `proxy`，可强制 IPv4；二维码请求失败会重试，扫码状态断线后继续轮询。
- 凭据、游标和 `context_token` 存在 `<dataDir>/clawbot/`；图片、语音、文件、视频只显示占位。
- 仅 1v1 且只能回复；不支持群聊、主动加好友或读取其他微信会话。
- 提示词页默认空模板，标题为「提示词」。
